caption: Fleet control plane architecture diagram
alt_text: Architecture diagram: robots connect over MQTT to the edge gateway, which forwards telemetry to the fleet control plane running on Kubernetes. The control plane writes to a PostgreSQL database and a time-series store, and exposes a REST API to the operator console.
ocr_text: Robot -> MQTT -> Edge Gateway -> Fleet Control Plane (Kubernetes) -> PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB. Operator Console -> REST API.
